OBSERVED: packages/queue/dispatch.ts claimDirectiveDispatch() returns MISSING when no DirectiveDispatch row exists for the BullMQ job pipelineRunId.
packages/queue/workers.ts processJob() treats every non-CLAIMED result other than COMPLETED as a normal JobState.CANCELLED result.
For claim=MISSING the worker returns commandResult='Dispatch record missing' instead of throwing/failing closed.
A returned result completes/acknowledges the BullMQ job without executing SWARM, while no durable dispatch authority exists to represent a legitimate cancellation.
Canonical cancellation is represented by an existing DirectiveDispatch row with status=CANCELLED; missing durable authority is therefore not equivalent to cancellation.
Inspected queue tests contain no oracle for claim=MISSING or the 'Dispatch record missing' path.
EXPECTED: A BullMQ job whose durable DirectiveDispatch authority is missing must fail closed as a data-integrity/dependency failure, not be acknowledged as CANCELLED.
The path must not execute SWARM or release output.
The failure must remain visible to durable incident/audit/alarm handling rather than disappearing as a successful worker completion.
A focused negative test must prove that missing durable dispatch authority cannot be normalized into a cancellation result.
